# Aadhya

> AI-powered women empowerment platform connecting women to government training, skill development, business opportunities, marketplace, mentorship, and financial guidance.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Aadhya — features, stories, schemes, and how it works.
- [Sign Up](/signup): Create an account to access training, schemes, and marketplace.
- [Log In](/login): Sign in to your Aadhya account.
